Class PoliceVehicle

java.lang.Object
traffic.model.Vehicle
traffic.model.EmergencyVehicle
traffic.model.PoliceVehicle
All Implemented Interfaces:
Movable
public class PoliceVehicle extends EmergencyVehicle
Visible Phase 2 patrol car. It drives along the street like an emergency vehicle and lets the TrafficController warn cars that are illegally waiting for a full curb. Phase 1 never spawns one of these — police patrol is part of the Phase 2 "managed" solution so students can see enforcement happening on screen, not just a number changing in the KPI panel.
